versions.changelog: v1.3.6: Fix PLG live game misclassified as completed
Refine: use 'finals' (not 'playoffs') for TPBL div=35 championship finals. TPBL now has separate semifinals (div=12, playoffs) and finals (div=35). --stage filter can distinguish between the two.
Fix: map division_id=35 for TPBL championship finals (總冠軍賽) stage classification. Previously mislabeled as regular season. Also update docstring with new division_id mapping.
v1.3.3: Camoufox fully replaced by Scrapling StealthyFetcher. Wiki API + TPBL box score scraper + all docs updated. Added skill.json + install instructions.
v1.3.2: TPBL Box Score via Camoufox scraping (API doesn't support boxscore endpoint, fallback to Camoufox)
v1.3.1: add --date param to games, include live matches in results, live scores default no-cache
v1.3.0: Stage filter, per-season teams, player aliases, wiki integration
Fix PLG parser regressions after site changes: upcoming 0:0 games no longer misclassified, and completed game scores now parse left/right columns correctly.
模組化 API 架構 新增即時比分 Box Score 訂閱提醒 交易資訊 SQLite 持久化 並修復 standings all 與 notify 參數問題
修復 TPBL standings 的 GP/排名問題 並統一 compare schema
v1.1.0: retry+backoff, disk caching, CJK table output, league leaders, player comparison, FG% accuracy fix
